scope: Focused read-only review of controlled planar simulation support, local ground-face recovery, original collision scorer reuse and same-route runner; no episode or physical-safety approval
findingsClosed: Original v2 seeded shared-edge <=5 degree component is retained; the new residual rule does not silently discard its sparse large triangles or curved low-slope ground.

Excluded microfaces are recovered only by fixed 20 cm square local patches on a 10 cm lattice, trained solely from original seeded ground vertices; local slope <=5 degrees, every recovered-face vertex within 2 mm, raw facet slope <=45 degrees, then final original shared-edge connectivity. No iterative or per-contact refit.

The ONE broad robust plane defines controlled actor support, not raw reference floor height or live ground truth. Raw geometry is unchanged, and every non-ground face remains in original swept obstacle scoring.
Original reference ownership, mesh revision and transform association remain checked, including plane-height queries.

Initial, midpoint and endpoint raw probes must hit selected ground and satisfy the unchanged 2 cm association to chosen planar foot Y. Previous-anchor continuity checks and missing/disconnected support rejection remain.

Continuous oriented actual-body and separate margin sweeps are unchanged. Each move has two support-adjusted halves, bounded total 3D distance, and no XZ or yaw repair. Contact, unknown support and invalid setup cannot become arrival.

Detached 1 cm tops, 1 cm bumps and risers, disconnected/drop support, walls and head geometry remain represented in authored regression fixtures. Original hole rays are not replaced by the infinite plane.
Runner metadata now separates retained original ground, local recovered-face residuals and broad planar actor support; prior failure cases and unexecuted proposal are preserved.

evidence.kind: Parent-executed final combined authored fixtures; reviewer inspected receipt/log and exact source pins, did not rerun

limits: This selects a simplified simulation ground model; it is not semantic floor truth, current phone clearance, general uneven-terrain validation or physical authorization.
Original ground component is a training assumption. Smooth ramp-like objects can be semantically ambiguous; low objects inside the declared 2 mm microgeometry band are not proven detectable.
Nine raw support rays remain finite samples, not continuous full-footprint support or measured-reference coverage.
The VTK scorer uses conservative swept box/surface intersections; full closed-solid containment and exact time of impact remain outside the established contract.
Ground triangle reports may repeat across envelopes and half-steps; they are not unique physical contact events.
No recorded mesh was loaded, game episode executed, outcome certified or frozen source edited by this reviewer in this task.
